text: Misadvertised. I kept seeing ads for this game where you need to rescue someone with some logical puzzles, but when I downloaded it it was more about tidying a garden and bursting bubbles in a candy crush like manner. It was still fun for a while with great graphics which is why I gave it 3 stars. But it's not the game I wanted and I couldn't figure out how to play the advertised game instead.

Boring. The ad show logic, problem solving game but the game is 3 in a row matching and there a far better 3 in a row games available. If you have difficulty clearing a level you either have to wait for an additional life or buy some, as it isn't the game that was advertised there is no way I would pay money to continue playing. Deleting it as soon as I've finished writing this.

False advertising. If you have seen an advert for this game where you choose items to either save or fail to save people in danger, please be aware that there is none of that in the game. It is a slow Candy Crush clone with too much nonsense in the way of the game which slows things down and makes it worse. I came for the game they advertised. I was disappointed.

I've been playing this game since autumn 2016, and it used to be more fun, but over the past 5 years, updates made the game horrible. The last update is thee worst, since you can't reload the game without losing a life and power ups. The renovations are ugly, require too many stars and are mostly pre-made. They took away seasonal decorations, my favourites. Expedition prizes are so not worth it. I haven't bought a golden ticket in years, too expensive. Thank you for ruining this game!

Game is nothing like the ads, from the pin pulling to the choose your own adventure type game play it's all non existent in this game. False advertising, and then when you get into the game and accept that it's a match 3 type game, you're forced to buy coins just to progress the game. An absolute scam. Don't waste your time with this garbage.

It's a fun game, but too many overly difficult levels and the Challenge Levels that appear circa 8000, are just money grabbers. You don't get stuck on it but it removes all your bonuses, and 1 life, if you don't clear it. They are just too difficult most of the time. Magic Hats are rubbish compared with Tresure Boxes, so half the week your bonuses aren't great either, so you'll likely get stuck for a while unless you pay a lot of money. Still... I've played a lot, so not all bad. 😂

the game is great. it's just that. the levels become super difficult, sometimes seems impossible to finish. there was this instance where i had an unlimited life for an hour. i spent the whole hour + the 5 lives (after the unli lives ran out) just trying to get pass a level. smh. and may i suggest that can you at least give 2 stars for hard and 3 stars for super hard level. BECAUSE THEY ARE INDEED SUPER HARD!!

I had this game before all those lying ads began to show up everywhere. The game is actually not bad, but since they are lying in their ads like crazy just to build up popularity, I will have to warn people. Gardenscapes is nothing like in the ads! If you're looking for candy crush with a story, this is what you want, but if you saw the ads, this is something completely different!

What a waste of time. You can spend weeks trying to get past a single level (unless you're willing to spend real money) so you can earn a measly star. And it is so frustrating how you have to use your stars for stupid reasons like starting a new day; making a phone call or buying the pointless pet dog a treat! I was really looking forward to the refurbishment of the gardens aspect to this game but it frustrated me so much that I deleted it! Don't bother!

I love this game. The puzzles are challenging (but not impossible!) and they get you hooked so easily. Of course, it takes a lot of patience, perseverance, careful thought and LUCK to beat the levels, but that's what makes it so fun. I agree that rewards for beating harder levels could be better, but i'm glad the latest update came with more chances to win coins and boosters via events and the daily spin. I've managed to hoard quite a lot this way, and also by being very frugal with spending/using them. Lastly, the plot and characters are just lovable & I enjoy restoring the garden very much. Easily my favourite game from the app store so far.

I uninstalled this game, been stuck on one level for days after I refused to spend more money for power ups. Some levels are just totally impossible to pass without spending money; you literally will have to buy loads of power ups and coins to pass. There are much more important things in life to spend money on rather than a misleading game to even begin with.

The game is fun, I like how you fix up the garden and all... but eventually the levels just got so hard that I was unable to get past them for days, which eventually led me to not playing the game and suninstalling the app to save space. Which is a shame, I would have loved to be able to finish up the garden and all, but fkr me it just became impossible...

Truly addictive yet rewarding game! The mockup puzzle surprisingly thoughtful, you need to think to solve it? The garden overall is mesmerizing, wish the flower bushes have variety though, since they all looks the same. Only gripe is that certain level can be close to impossible, you need a lot of luck and retries, not good since certain level can be frustrating to deal... Stars? Oh boy! They're very expensive, beating hard level didn't give you more stars, only coins... Overall? ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

After playing for several years and deleting and redownloading, several times due to crappy algorithims, not letting you pass levels, I've finally deleted this game for good. I was on level 3000 and something for both gardenscapes and homescapes, and literally could spend a week or two stuck on one level. This game has nothing to do with skill. When the algorithms decide you've played the level enough you're given all the pieces you need to progress all of a sudden. Doesn't make it fun sorry

It is a fun game and it is very satisfying to recover the garden. It is nice that it has been fixed so you get two stars for really tough levels, I still find it too rare that you get two stars, but it is better. Now it is a problem that the "tough" levels are not allways so tough and sometimes a "normal" level are super dificult (eg. level 556). Also when you use the showel to remove a fruit besides a flowerbed, the flowers does not grow... That does not make sense to me.

Trying it out to see if my grandkids would enjoy it. I am of the opinion they all will - even the 3 year old! I got rather engrossed, and am enjoying it myself, even though it is rather slow and a bit wordy. Added later: As I have progressed through levels and updates, I have found the game more complicated and challenging, even though young grandchildren have enjoyed early scenes. As a comment, I would love Austin to be more environmentally friendly!

Played for years, but the rewards have decreased substantially in the last year, and the costs have significantly increased recently (1/3 more), as well as harder levels, making progress near impossible without lots of money. Feedback given by many players, but we've all been dismissed. Greed, unfortunately, and no recognition of long-term players who have spent money to play a game that used to be enjoyable.

I played this game in my free time for years! Loved it and enjoyed have my free time spent on it as it was fun. But now I'm stuck on some levels for days and will not let me pass even when I pay for upgrades and more turns and by the offers they provide when not completing the level. I feel like the game is now only about money and not fun.

The game itself isn't bad but is serious clickbait advatising! Any options anywhere? No. The ad does not mention half of the game involving candy crush like levels, or that you need stars to access new areas. I like the three options, but you've got to stop the clickbait with the options on all of your apps. The same clickbait is on Fishdom as well and Township.

False advertising. The challenges in the ads are not in the game. All ads by this gaming developer are false. Just a regular switch game which after a round completed you acquire the item needed to decorate a specific section of the home. I'm giving a 1 star rating because I downloaded the game due to an ad and didn't see what was shown at all. LIES!

Stop looking for a favourite matching game. You have found it. I am playing this game for more than 2 years now and no other game can top it (including others of these guys). I'm at level 4456 and I'm still enjoying it. I did not spend a penny (as I can't)! No level is unbeatable, you just have to keep trying. Every level has its own strategy to win, find it and your shall pass. The graphics and design is beautiful and it keeps getting better. Would give more stars if it was possible!

Great little game. Can play just the main game or get involved with the whole story. You can interact and help other players on your team. The game is easy enough to get through the levels, but challenging enough to keep you interested. I am nearly at level 3000 and have not spent a cent, although some levels took several attempts. There are pleny of ways to acquire free lives in the game, so for those whining about the game; start using ya grey matter, as there are strategies to win for free.

Really enjoyed going back on this game and playing but now I'm at a complete standstill...I can go through the levels but I can't progress on the story, as I'm now on to opening a new level which won't load. I clicked "open new area." it takes the stars, then sits, saying there is an update, but nothing loads - I've left it 2hrs "updating" but it was still on 0%. Despite it showing no needed updates on the playstore - so im super confused

Imagine ordering a blue top and you get a pink dress instead. That's how this game is. False advertisement. Don't know which genius in the creative department came up with "hey guys, let's lie in the ads, make them install the game and maybe they will stick around!" and everybody applauded. This game is a lie and a waste of time. Here's some useful feedback.

Good game to start with. But after passing many stages you will come to certain games where you cannot move forward without buying gold! They want you to spend money to buy gold and fire power. They limited number of moments and rewards to clear stage. I spent enough. Good game ,time killer but going to uninstall.

I've been playing this game for 7+ years. Why have you gotten rid of the options to design the garden how you want to? I've spent tons of money on a game that seems harder for people over level 7000 and give you less in return? The rewards have become poor, choices removed and levels so difficult it's almost entirely p2w. It's a shame...

How is there not a confirmation when selecting(by mistake!) to continue on with 5 extra lives...for 900coins???? Come on....there is also something you earn through playing and then to unlock it, you have to pay real money.....and some levels get practically impossible, you play them for days to no avail. Essentially forcing you to pay real money once again to get items that might help pass....I mean....what brought me here though was that lack of confirmation when I accidentally pressed 900coins for 5 extra lives....fuming.

Completely different to the game shown in the advert I saw. I think developers who do this sort of stuff should get actual consequences for false advertising. This game is 3rd in the most popular games section of the play store, however probably at least a quater (more I suspect) of the players who have installed were expecting an interesting puzzle/story game and got an awful, boring game. Unless you were expecting a garden renovation game or whatever this is, I would not recommend installing!

The mini games that have been advertised are not available when playing the game. I've reached level 1324 and only been able to play two mini games. The app also just uploaded and is running slow and glitches. Game is frustrating, you only have 5 lives and as it increases the normal levels seem more difficult than the "hard" or "super hard" levels. You need certain extras to pass and if you pay for them, you end up spending more money. The game is addictive and has fun elements.

I used to play this and enjoyed it, but then it became ridiculously difficult to pass levels and I'd spend anything up to a week or longer trying to pass it. Recently I've been playing another game and the ad kept coming up for garden scapes, I thought it may have changed cause it looked great, but no, the ad is very misleading. you shouldn't try to trick people into playing a game with false advertisements and you could definitely make the game better by running it the same as the ad.

The ads for this game are out of control. This is a match 3 to renovate the garden game, absolutely not "save the girl" or "pull the pins" puzzle. Maybe in a single bonus level here and there so they don't get sued. Now they're going even further as to mock the previous ads by saying xi found a game EXACTLY like this!!" But it's still not true? Why all the lies??

I am disappointed in how expensive the deals have become and how smaller and smaller the rewards have become. Now it costs more for the full chest and it used to be 5000 coins, now only 3000 coins for the same amount of money. I have been playing this game for 8 years and really enjoyed it until recently, I dont mind the difficult levels, and I spend money on this game every month, but I also want to earn more coins and have more deals for being as loyal as I am. Really disappointed.

A challenging and fun game, however when issues occur it's difficult to get help. I've been trying for several days to get rewards I am owed, restarted my phone twice, spoke to two separate customer helpers & I am still without the rewards. I have spent money in this game and I'm feeling quite angry that free rewards which are substantial have not been given. I'm now stuck, unable to move forward without these rewards & I wasted money on a golden ticket as I'm unable to pass any levels.

Pathetic. The rewards verses the "cost" of competing is miles apart. I can spend days on the same level and unless I use my credit card to purchase more credit then that is where i will stay. I am not prepared to buy credits. You get to within 1 or 2 moves to compete a level on if you want to play on you need 900 credits. I could play for a week and not earn that many credits . If I am fortunate to pass a level even the winning reward is pathetic.

This would be a great game if it weren't for them trying to force you to buy bombs and lives. In the level I'm stuck on they've chained two multicoloured discs up. There's no way to unchain them except blow them up and the chances of a bomb forming close enough is small. This wouldn't be a problem except two of the gnomes I need to get off the level are stuck under them. Normally I would just keep trying until things line up but I only have 5 lives. I refuse to pay to get past the level.

I'm a big fan of this game, had it a few years, and find it a fun way to pass the time! Recently, though, the costs to buy coins have skyrocketed, which even though Gardenscapes claim you don't need to, there are levels where you don't get enough moves to complete the level, so if you want to progress you do need those coins. The biggest hit to the skyrocketing costs though is 'the golden ticket'. Why is it now £8.99?! Shame on your greedy selves. Don't think I'll be playing from now on.

Is really fun but what initially brought me towards the game was the puzzle solving scenarios following an ad from another game, and then you soon find out that isnt actually the main play in this game - bit mis leading given the interactive ad. As for level 149 - I'm sure it is possible to complete it and despite watching numerous walkthrough, I've been stuck on it 3 days straight and missed out by 1 piece 5 times. Ended up uninstalling as a result - maybe I'm a bad loser!

False advertising! it's just another version of candy crush, not the one it shows in the previews. I have not seen any of the challenges that you's advertise so far, I keep playing it thinking maybe you have to be a higher level but no I was wrong. If you like games like candy crush geuss it's ok to download, but if your here for the puzzles and helping the characters out don't get it.

Pretty similar to most match three customizing games, it lacks a lot in customization options for certain things, so aside from the entertainment of match threes, it's overall pretty bland. There should be a way to skip the cinematics (e.g. The butler interacting with things for a while after you've chosen it) just like you can with the text bubbles. It's also a bit annoying that swapping bombs together doesn't create any sort of combo like most games of this kind.

I'm at level 445, but I never met this mini games on advertising!!! And their goal is to force you to pay! I use to delete the game for a week, then when I come back they give me a lot of rewards, I play for few days and leave again. It's very annoying that they wanna manipulate your game to force you to pay!!! We are not stupid dude!

I absolutely loved this game but I'm starting to get frustrated with it. I expect the levels to get harder as you progress but some levels can take up to a week to complete and you end up missing out on the prizes etc. It leaves you no chance to complete rooms or anything. The waiting time for lives is way too long too. Half an hour for 1 life to restore is ridiculous especially how quick they can be used. Requesting and sending lives is frustrating too!

I have had this game for just over two years. It started off as a lovely game and occasionally you'd get stuck on a level for a few days but then you'd do it and move on. Now I'm on the higher levels (well into the 1000) it's nearly impossible to beat the levels but then you get a lot more hard or super hard levels. It makes you feel like you need a lot of power ups and coins just to beat them and then your stuck again. It feels more like a money grabbing game and less for enjoyment

I used to love this game when it was about building gardens. Then I would spend most of the time retrieving frisbies of roofs or finding the stupid dog. I play now due to an addictive personality and have no joy doing so. You give a hard level every 3 to 4 levels but the problem is all the other levels are just as hard and can't win without spending money. There is no skill in the bonus wheel as it speeds up or instantly slows down to make sure you don't get the jackpot.

JUST ANOTHER DUMB MATCHING GAME I don't care how the game is, your advertisement is misleading and very frustrating, the game ads are completely different from the actual game, how is this not FRAUD? And don't tell that gameplay shown in ad will be available after 500 hours of gameplay or spending a fortune on the game. This was a horrible experience. This needs to stop.

False advertising!! None of the adverts of the game are accurate descriptions of what the game does. I've seen so many different adverts that depict completely different games, which I think they do that to capture more people and get higher download ratings. This is unethical and they should receive fines or have their game removed from the app store.

Love this game been playing for very long but what I don't like is that you get stuck every now and then on a difficult level for days! And then only way to pass is to buy boosters and spend money. Yes there must be difficult levels but to sit on one for 3 or 4 days is just not fun to play anymore and only get one booster a day. And everyone I know playing this game as well is feeling the same way and many deleted the game.

Great game that flows well until you reach a level that clearly is designed for you to fail every time, no matter how well you plan your moves. It's clear that while this game is free, after a short while the makers want to make their money buy encouraging you to buy boosters in order to continue. They give you a good taster to hook you in then stop making the levels ones you can pass without paying for help. They should just give a set price when downloading and leave it at that.

The game is rigged. When playing to match certain things it stops and tells you that you have no more moves when there's tons more moves. Then it eats up all your points and tells you to buy more hearts to keep playing. I gave up because it's rigged and it kept lying in order to get me to use or buy more points. It's fine if it was actually difficult and I legitimately needed to buy more but it is dishonest. So it's a huge no from me. Only bonus is no adds, pleasant game and good graphics.

I downloaded this game because of an in-app ad. I was so disappointed to be playing a matching game instead. That is not to say it isn't a great game, it is - but the ad was misleading, fix that. Also, I go through hard levels trying to beautiful the garden according to my taste, and all of a sudden 'I have' to change some things because Austin doesn't like it, or cos some artist painted something. Overall, if the game was advertised for what it really was, I'd have given it 5-star...

Once again, your levels are almost impossible to pass, which forces players to spend money. Your game is now becoming a money making scheme which will leave most players uninterested to continue playing. Not everyone has that capacity to spend on your game. Not to mention how expensive it is to extend events. It is a pattern, this happens everytime you have events or certain tasks to complete.

i'm a long time player but this company becoming more greedy to make us pay for the items. i used to pay money for the events until i realized they made it super difficult to collect coins and solving the puzzles. i mean we used to get 50coins for the minimum after solving 1 level, now it went down to 10. LMAO. are you really desperate to make us pay for you? Seriously, This game is no longer worth to play. for new players, don't bother to download the game. it's wasting your time.

Addictive, difficulty curve is excellent, beautiful graphics, fun story and easy ui. Levels are challenging but doable. A little planning and a little luck make this a satisfying experience. No money needed, just patience and brain power. To those who find the difficulty too high; don't give up hope, you'd be surprised how many times things fall into place in the final few moves. Level 3000 and counting. Loving the new sections.

I like the game, I like the challenge but after awhile my determination left me. The game is too hard, the rewards you get after time and times of trying is not very encouraging. Cost too much to get the extension to finish the game, in the end I just get sick of it and don't want to play anymore. I think I'll uninstall it...there's no more fun in the game..really sad. I like the game and still playing .. may be the developer could rewards each game you won by replacing the boosters you used.

just when I thought, this game was better, something annoying came up just like It always happened with the other. I have reached level 29, it was hard, the hardest without boosters, I mean what do you expect? people buying coins so we can play unlimited? If buying is not possible, I dont mind watching ads as long as its not too many . come on, games are supposed to be fun.

First 10 minutes of the game are great, then it turns into every other game designed to drain your wallet, a sudden difficulty spike so you have to keep spending real money to progress. The quicker these vermin companies are banned the better, i'd have rather paid £10 for the game without constantly being asked to spend money just to progress.

Don't bother with this game!!Utter greed of the company behind this game takes all the fun out of it. The levels get to the point that there is no way you can even get close to passing a level without paying for more coins and explosives etc- these don't help very often, the game feels rigged to make you spend more money. The additional game is equally frustrating as you cannot move forward very far because you need to use a lot of energy/points to move objects out of your way. Very expensive!!!

Gardenscapes was a very fun game until the blowing up tanks showed up. I stopped playing other games because they did the same thing, it seems the only way to beat the blowing up tanks is to pay money which to me feels like extortion, another excellent game ruined by something totally beyond control. Which reminds me who has propane or gas tanks in their garden anyways!!!

Misleading ads. Nothing like how they promote this game. What you see in the ads is a very tiny (about 2%) side to the main game every now and again. The actual game itself would probably be ok if its what you're looking for... But it's not as fun, exciting or playable as the ads make it look. Google need to clamp down on this false advertising. I'm guessing this is what's eld to a host of underwhelming reviews.

I think my previous review was removed, but I'm here again to say that the base game itself and the events are not bad, it's a solid match 3 game. The ads, however, are completely atrocious, as someone who actually pays attention to the story and characters, the ads are a complete lie and a scam, the woman are the girl are not even related, and there is no such thing as "unlocking all levels" the minigames are present but optional and are fairly easy, and the background music is needlessly sad.

Over 5 years of playing this game and I still love it. Level 4085. The game has changed a lot over the years and this is what I've found: The new mini games are really engaging, and the competitive nature spurs you on up the levels. The garden tasks are less tedious as you progress through the game. No one wants to rebuild something they've already made. The story has really sweet moments and I've had to screen grab them. I do miss the seasons items as redecorating my garden was half the fun.

This has some of the most misleading ads In the damn galaxy. In the ads, the game actually looked alright. But when you boot up the game, it's just a match 3 game (the bottom of the barrel when it comes to game developing.) I mean the cutscenes look alright, but the game is utter trash. DO NOT INSTALL THIS GAME!

I used to like this game a lot, but as with the reviews from many others, to the levels have gotten ridiculously difficult, to the point it's no longer enjoyable. I do like a challenge, but this is supposed to be entertainment, not lead to frustration. I'm not sure if it's a way to get players to purchase add ons. With Homescapes at least you get the opportunity to have boosts every seven days to help you beat the level. But not with Gardenscapes. You end up stuck on the same level for days.

Its nothing like the ad. It too different from what is shown in the video. I would really like it if the advertisement depicted something right. The ad looked fun and the whole doesnt exist in the real game. you are losing customers by false advertising. I didnt download any of your other games due to this reason. I will suggest you show the real gameplay. You will get way many customers than you have now.

At first i gave 5stars, but i am lowering down to 2 because i am stuck in level 25 because some puzzles are too hard, ive been trying for 2 days, and cant pass the level. you only have 5 lives and for each puzzle you only get one star to do chores, ao you have to wait twenty minutes each time..it got very frustrating at this point i am about to quit. there is no help or clues at all to help us on the puzzles...so 2 stars, one because the game could offer so much more and two because it is cute.

When will you guys address the many reviews that point out the false advertising with this game? I, too, saw an ad for this game in another game and found it intriguing. This game has nothing to do with the ad. Does the "find your way out of situation" challenge ever happen in the game? This is super frustrating as you are blatantly lying to us.

Having played this game for over 2 years, I've officially seen my motivation to continue drop. The maps are repetitive and impossible to complete without spending money. The 50% discount hour was a fantastic idea that actually made me want to play again. This map didn't have that anymore and as a result I hardly played. The fun is gone this way. Bring back decoration challenges and fewer maps. And don't remove the 50%. Keep it doable.

I have enjoy playing this game. Storyline is interesting but it can take me ages to get through some very difficult levels. I cannot afford to buy coins so I can only keep on trying! I quite agree with the other players 900 coins for extra 5 moves is a lot and getting a level complete only get around 50+ coins as reward. Thanks for the lovely game and please don't make them too hard to play. I can play this game for hours. Thanks for the extra competitions which enable me to win the hours to play. Best game I have play. Thank you.

First off, the ads are completely fraudulent. Absolutely not what it advertises and is in fact a COMPLETELY different game... It's a candy crush style game with the task of building up a beautiful garden. But instead of building up your garden you're burdened with so many tasks to waste the points you get from beating the levels and you cant skip those irrelevant tasks..... the levels get so difficult and the mundane tasks cost more and more stars. Big waste of time and not even what the add is

i absolutely love this game. i've been playing it for four years now, and even though occasionally i've felt like i had to buy powerup bundles, i really like the gameplay and story. But lately i've had an issue; i'm using a 2015 Galaxy J5, and the phone is in good condition, but the game keeps freezing. I've updated everything, tried cleaning cache, restarting etc, but no matter what i do the game just won't load :( Is this something that might be fixed with the next update?

Update: I have reached a point where I cannot solve a certain level (3086), so I have two suggestions for you to avoid my unistalling the game (I do not feel like playing anymore). 1) To give the player the chance to pass a level with 900 gold after, say, 100 attempts. 2) Do not increase the cost in stars of the goals when the game is more difficult! ! It's not logical, you frustrate the player. I wish you read this.

Loved it at first. Very addictive, but still waiting for the puzzle game? It became obvious after a while that the normal levels were made unusually difficult so you will spend your money. It's annoying when you are 1 move away from winning and you run out of moves. I spent over $20 in a week just to advance. In fact spending money is the only way to beat some levels. I uninstalled it when the money baiting became obvious. And Google play should do something about the misleading ad.

Edited review Just when you thought it couldn't get worse - it did! Now without warning they've removed the free energy timer in expeditions, allegedly to focus on match 3 levels but I've had none of those. So once I'm stuck on a level I'm stuck for the whole day or longer, with no possibility to earn. Game no longer fun. Losing things you've earned (or even paid for) just because you can't finish the level makes the game less enjoyable and completely unfair. Used to enjoy it, not any more

Another money grabbing in-app purchase game :( It is playable for about a week without spending £2 or £3 on extras but after that becomes so funstrating you've had enough. The game has no skill progression; the only way to progress past higher levels is by purchasing extras. Terrible business practice of slipping low cost in-app purchases past you each day to progress. You could buy a PC or console AAA game for just a few days play.

Nothing like the ads. The annoying mini pop-up games with pins where you have to remove one to rescue a character... yes well that is fake. It does not feature in the real game at all. Real game is more like a cheap and painfully slow build your own village type game and you CANNOT make progress withOUT spending REAL money. Don't waste your time!

The game is good but I feel like this app is too greedy. We are allowed only 5 plays until it run out and have to wait for 30 mins to refill. This gets very frustrating considering the levels get harder and harder. And it always makes me feel like I have to pay money to get through. It is such a pity because the game could be good and addictive. I can stand a few adds for your revenue but I don't think it is worth paying money. I am uninstalling.

I downloaded it because I found the adverts for this game to be fun, only to find the game is a matching game and not like advertised! I already play homescapes and this is so similar it's not worth having/playing both, especially when it takes ages to pass the levels when you refuse to pay real money on an app. Overall it's ok, just not what I wanted.

It's a good game and can be addictive, but some of the levels are really difficult and takes numerous tries to complete. The amount of stars needed for some of the tasks is ridiculous ! It seems a shame because people will get bored of not getting anywhere with the game and will uninstall it. Please take this into consideration and maybe make the tasks more accessible.

I've played this game for years and enjoyed it. But there's been some changes lately that affects how the how pieces move, that makes it unpredictable and more in the hands of rng than skill. Which incentiveses purchases. In the last month or so, I've seen more and more bugs. Empty tiles, tips for moves you can't make etc. And today I've noticed they doubled the prices for power ups in the store. Shame to see greed got the best of them, and they now deliver a worse game for a higher price.

Very frustrating game and it leads to anger in a weird psychological way.. suggested moves by the game don't make sense. The game is not built on smart moves but on trial. Take for example level 269 one side of the screen has moves, the other side has no moves .. Replaying a level for 30 times with no logical solution is not the proper way of designing a game!!! If there is less than 1 star I would have voted that!
